output.summary: The record FY2026 results are mostly a commodity price effect: revenue rose 46.5% while bushels fell 0.9%, and peers without new programs grew a median 41%. The 6% cost-per-bushel gain comes from maintenance cut by about a third, while the deferred backlog grew to 3.1 times its FY2024 level. The insurer found critical dust and monitoring failures at Harlan Junction, and the July near-miss was never investigated. Dryer and grading knowledge sits with one person nearing retirement. The expansion proposal rests on FY2026 prices and unsupported volume assumptions. Fix the hazards, capture the knowledge, and defer the vote until the financial case is rebuilt on normalized prices. Do not freeze maintenance spending.
